title: 第519章 恭请女帝第518章 女帝又如何
content_zh:
第519章恭请女帝
全场再次死寂。
所有人都瞪大了眼睛，难以置信地看着凌清雪。
她说什么？
就算女帝亲临，她也不怕？
这是何等的自信？
这是何等的霸气？
齐王的脸色惨白如纸，他张了张嘴，想要说些什么，却发现自己一个字都说不出来。
他本来想搬出女帝来压凌清雪，可万万没想到，凌清雪不但不怕，反而直接说就算女帝亲临，也不怕。
叶倾心第一个反应过来，激动得差点跳起来，一双大眼睛闪闪发光，拉着唐雨烟的袖子使劲摇晃：
“雨烟姐！你听到了吗！老祖说就算女帝来了她也不怕！太帅了！太霸气了！”
唐雨烟被她摇得东倒西歪，却也不由自主地露出了笑容：
“听到了听到了，你别摇了，再摇我的袖子都要被你扯破了……”
话虽如此，她自己的目光却也一直停留在凌清雪身上，眼中满是敬佩与向往。
这就是剑尊的底气吗？
这就是绝世强者的风采吗？
面对大乾女帝的威名，非但不惧，反而敢于正面叫板！
这等气魄，这等胆识，简直让人心驰神往！
而青云剑宗的弟子们，此刻更是激动得满脸通红，恨不得当场欢呼出声！
“老祖威武！”

“老祖霸气！”
“有老祖在，我们青云剑宗谁也不怕！”
一声声呐喊此起彼伏，响彻整片荒原。
原本以为今天必死无疑，没想到峰回路转，宗门居然有这样一位霸气侧漏的老祖坐镇！
连女帝都不怕，区区齐王府又算得了什么？
而那些外来剑修，此刻也是议论纷纷。
“我的天，这位老祖也太猛了吧？连女帝都敢叫板？”
“她可是剑尊啊！剑尊大能，哪个不是心高气傲之辈？怎么可能被一个名头就吓住？”
“话是这么说没错，可女帝陛下也不是吃素的啊……我听说女帝陛下的修为，早就已经深不可测了！”
“嘘，这种话你也敢乱说？小心隔墙有耳！”
“怕什么？这里又不是王都，女帝陛下还能听到不成？”
“也是……不过话说回来，这位老祖是真的猛，我是真佩服她！”
而在天剑阁的阵营中，叶惊云也是久久无言。
他看着凌清雪那道淡蓝色的身影，眼中满是复杂之色。
他原本以为，凌清雪虽然修为高深，但面对大乾女帝这样的存在，多少会有些忌惮。
可他万万没有想到，凌清雪居然如此强硬，如此霸道，连女帝都不放在眼里！
“这位青云剑宗老祖到底是什么来历，连女帝陛下都不怕？”
而此刻，齐王姜尚的脸色已经难看到了极点。
他的嘴唇哆嗦着，脸色一阵青一阵白，双拳紧握，指甲深深嵌入掌心，几乎要掐出血来。
他原本以为，搬出女帝的名号，多少能让凌清雪有所忌惮。

可他却想到，这凌清雪简直天不怕地不怕，连大乾女帝都不怕。
这让他怎么办？
他还能怎么办？
content_en:
Chapter 519 Respectfully Invite the Empress
The whole place was dead silent again.
Everyone stared at Ling Qingxue in disbelief.
What did she say?
Even if the empress comes in person, is she not afraid?
How confident is this?
How domineering is this?
King Qi's face was as pale as paper. He opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but found that he could not say a word.
He originally wanted to move out the Empress to suppress Ling Qingxue, but he never expected that Ling Qingxue not only was not afraid, but directly said that she would not be afraid even if the Empress came in person.
Ye Qingxin was the first to react, almost jumping with excitement, her big eyes sparkling, she pulled Tang Yuyan's sleeves and shook her vigorously:
"Sister Yuyan! Did you hear that? The ancestor said that she would not be afraid even if the empress comes! She is so handsome! So domineering!"
Tang Yuyan was shaken by her, but she couldn't help but smile:
"I heard it, I heard it. Stop shaking it. If you shake it again, my sleeves will be torn by you..."
Even so, her own eyes remained on Ling Qingxue, her eyes full of admiration and yearning.
Is this the sword master’s confidence?
Is this the style of a peerless strong man?
Faced with the reputation of Empress Daqian, not only was she not afraid, but she dared to challenge her head-on!
Such courage and courage are simply fascinating!
As for the disciples of Qingyun Sword Sect, their faces were flushed with excitement at this moment, and they wished they could cheer on the spot!
"The ancestor is mighty!"
"Ancestor is domineering!"
"As long as our ancestor is here, we, the Qingyun Sword Sect, are not afraid of anyone!"
Screams came and went, resounding throughout the wasteland.
I originally thought that I would definitely die today, but I didn't expect that the sect would turn out to have such a domineering and sinister ancestor in charge!
If you're not even afraid of the Empress, what does Prince Qi's palace mean?
And those foreign sword cultivators were also talking a lot at this moment.
"Oh my god, isn't this ancestor too fierce? He even dares to challenge the empress?"
"She is the Sword Master! The Sword Master is a powerful person. Who is not a proud and arrogant person? How could she be intimidated by just a name?"
"That's true, but Her Majesty the Empress is not a vegetarian... I heard that Her Majesty's cultivation has long been unfathomable!"
"Hush, how dare you say such nonsense? Be careful, walls have ears!"
"What are you afraid of? This is not the royal capital. Can Her Majesty the Queen still hear it?"
"That's true...but having said that, this ancestor is really fierce, I really admire her!"
In the Tianjian Pavilion camp, Ye Jingyun was also speechless for a long time.
He looked at Ling Qingxue's light blue figure, his eyes full of complex colors.
He originally thought that although Ling Qingxue had advanced cultivation, she would be a little wary when faced with a being like Empress Daqian.
But he never expected that Ling Qingxue would be so tough and domineering, even the Empress didn't take her seriously!
"What is the origin of this ancestor of the Qingyun Sword Sect? That he is not even afraid of Her Majesty the Empress?"
At this moment, Qi Wang Jiang Shang's expression turned extremely ugly.
His lips were trembling, his face was turning blue and white, his fists were clenched, and his nails were deeply embedded in his palms, almost causing bleeding.
He originally thought that using the title of empress would make Ling Qingxue somewhat afraid.
But he thought that Ling Qingxue was fearless, not even the Empress Daqian.
What does this make him do?
What else could he do?
